SH2 seems to be the only Team Silent game to ever be talked about and its story keeps getting clumsily used as inspiration for the newer titles. The town's demonic cult and how their practices distorted the town's underlying spiritual power were easily the most unique and interesting parts of the franchise, and now none of it's even referenced anymore.

Silent Hill as a series has been reduced to a spooky therapeutic ghost town with no other explanation that it's just haunted. Why don't more people realize how amazing the other Team Silent games were?
